_context_order.prompt: Describe the story in broad strokes.
What is the current scene in the story?
What are the current narrative arcs?
What are the relevant details? Start with a list of relevant characters.
Now, describe each of the relevant characters.
Now, retrieve specific lines earlier in the story that might be relevant.

importance_scale:
Importance Scale (magnitude 0-100; faction=positive/negative/neutral):
Each level blends SALIENCE (how often the subject's thoughts and actions are shaped by this) with WEIGHT (how central, irreplaceable, and defining it is). A high score needs BOTH: constant presence without weight caps near 50, and weight without presence caps too. The scale measures LONG-TERM standing -- not a single scene's moment-to-moment urgency. It reads the same across ALL entity types: a score means the same for a character, a group, an element, or an event. 'Positive' covers an ally, a boon, or a benign presence; 'Negative' a rival, a threat, or a harmful force.

100 Obsessive -- Defines their identity. Thoughts and actions orbit it completely; no substitute exists. Positive: would burn the world for it. Negative: all-consuming vendetta, cannot coexist.
 90 Paramount -- The single most important presence in their life. Positive: would die for it without pause. Negative: mortal enemy, the top priority to defeat or escape.
 80 Profound -- A core pillar, proven through shared experience. Positive: ride-or-die, entrusted with life and secrets. Negative: intense, actively-maintained hatred, invested in its ruin.
 75 Strong -- A significant, actively-maintained bond or asset. Positive: close friend or beloved family; real personal risk taken for it. Negative: bitter grudge with genuine conflict history.
 70 Significant -- Dependable and consistent. Positive: trusted comrade, a reliable tool or ally. Negative: open antagonist, regular opposition, consistent friction.
 60 Notable -- Regular engagement that carries weight. Positive: recurring associate, steady resource. Negative: recurring rival, satisfaction in its setbacks.
 50 Meaningful -- A real presence with history, now largely peripheral. Positive: lasting fondness or minor leverage. Negative: mild but remembered resentment.
 40 Moderate -- Known, with some history. Positive: friendly acquaintance; comfortable when paths cross. Negative: mild dislike, minor real friction.
 30 Mild -- Vaguely defined but present. Positive: cordial, favorable but distant. Negative: slight distrust, vague wariness.
 20 Slight -- Barely registers. Positive: exists in the positive periphery. Negative: occasional minor irritation, near-neutral.
 10 Negligible -- Essentially neutral; not worth tracking as a meaningful dimension.
  0 None -- Carries no weight; stranger or irrelevant.

100 is the absolute extreme -- obsessive devotion or an all-consuming need. Most meaningful tracked entities sit 50-80; below 40 is background noise and filters out of default relevance thresholds. Below 20 is not worth storing. Scores are continuous, so in-between values are fine and expected -- a nemesis you plan every move around, the vault key the plot turns on, or the faction you founded and still lead are all ~85; a sibling who anchors your choices ~80; a trusty sidearm used daily ~70; this scene's setpiece (present but disposable) ~40; a childhood friend grown distant ~50; a one-scene extra ~10.
current_scene:
## Current Scene
{% for state_name, state_data in [('Start', data.start), ('Now', data.now)] %}
Scene {{state_name}} --- {{data.what}} <<<<<<<<<<<< {{path}}.current_scene.{{state_name}}, {{path}}.current_scene.what
Characters -- {% set chars = state_data.who.characters.values()|list if state_data.who.characters is mapping else state_data.who.characters %}{% for c in chars %}{{c.name}} @ {{c.location}}{% if not loop.last %}, {% endif %}{% endfor %} <<<<<<<<<<<< {{path}}.current_scene.{{state_name}}.who.characters
Groups -- {% set grps = state_data.who.groups.values()|list if state_data.who.groups is mapping else state_data.who.groups %}{% for g in grps %}{{g.name}} @ {{g.location}}{% if not loop.last %}, {% endif %}{% endfor %} <<<<<<<<<<<< {{path}}.current_scene.{{state_name}}.who.groups
When -- {{state_data.when.date}} - {{state_data.when.time}} ({{state_data.when.specific_time}}) <<<<<<<<<<<< {{path}}.current_scene.{{state_name}}.when
Where -- {{state_data.where}} <<<<<<<<<<<< {{path}}.current_scene.{{state_name}}.where
{% endfor %}
Messages in this scene (from message metadata) -- {{ metadata | scene_messages(data._scene_number if data._scene_number is defined else None) | length }} <<<<<<<<<<<< {{path}}.current_scene.messages

chapters:
## Chapters
{% for chapter in data %}
{% if chapter is mapping %}Chapter [{{loop.index}}] --- {{chapter.title}} <<<<<<<<<<<< {{path}}.chapters[{{loop.index0}}]
Status --- {{chapter.status}} <<<<<<<<<<<< {{path}}.chapters[{{loop.index0}}].status
Scenes --- {{(chapter.scenes.values()|list|join(', ')) if chapter.scenes is mapping else (chapter.scenes|join(', ') if chapter.scenes else '')}} <<<<<<<<<<<< {{path}}.chapters[{{loop.index0}}].scenes
Summary --- {{chapter.summary}} <<<<<<<<<<<< {{path}}.chapters[{{loop.index0}}].summary
Key Changes --- <<<<<<<<<<<< {{path}}.chapters[{{loop.index0}}].key_changes

{% endfor %}{% else %}Chapter [{{loop.index}}] --- {{chapter}} <<<<<<<<<<<< {{path}}.chapters[{{loop.index0}}]
{% endif %}

{% if arc is mapping %}Arc [{{loop.index}}] --- {{arc.title}} <<<<<<<<<<<< {{path}}.arcs[{{loop.index0}}]
{% if arc.status %}Status --- {{arc.status}} <<<<<<<<<<<< {{path}}.arcs[{{loop.index0}}].status
{% endif %}{% if arc.starting_chapter is defined and arc.ending_chapter is defined %}Span --- chapters {{arc.starting_chapter}} - {{arc.ending_chapter}} <<<<<<<<<<<< {{path}}.arcs[{{loop.index0}}].starting_chapter
{% endif %}Chapters --- {{(arc.chapters.values()|list|join(', ')) if arc.chapters is mapping else (arc.chapters|join(', ') if arc.chapters else '')}} <<<<<<<<<<<< {{path}}.arcs[{{loop.index0}}].chapters
Summary --- {{arc.summary}} <<<<<<<<<<<< {{path}}.arcs[{{loop.index0}}].summary
{% if arc.plot_threads and arc.plot_threads is iterable and not arc.plot_threads is string %}Plot Threads --- {{((arc.plot_threads.values()|list) if arc.plot_threads is mapping else arc.plot_threads)|join('; ')}} <<<<<<<<<<<< {{path}}.arcs[{{loop.index0}}].plot_threads
{% endif %}{% if arc.character_arcs %}Character Arcs --- {{arc.character_arcs}} <<<<<<<<<<<< {{path}}.arcs[{{loop.index0}}].character_arcs
{% endif %}{% if arc.relationship_shifts %}Relationship Shifts --- {{arc.relationship_shifts}} <<<<<<<<<<<< {{path}}.arcs[{{loop.index0}}].relationship_shifts
{% endif %}{% else %}Arc [{{loop.index}}] --- {{arc}} <<<<<<<<<<<< {{path}}.arcs[{{loop.index0}}]
{% endif %}

{% endfor %}
